description: Self-hosted Renovate run (.github/workflows/components.yml). It follows the Components' release tags and opens one pull request per release that moves the submodule and refreshes both lock files. The hosted Renovate app reads renovate.json only, never this file.

customManagers.description: The release of nv-rs the submodule is pinned at (its pin file under components/, which scripts/bump-component.sh keeps equal to the release-please manifest of the commit checked out in the submodule); each later release tag of its repository is an update.

packageRules.description: loot-rs moves with nvmod (ADR-0015): the bump script takes the loot-rs tag nvmod links, so a loot-rs release alone is not an update here until nvmod links it.

nv-rs is held out of the follower until 2026-11-24 23:10 UTC (#384, #472): its newest releases need zip 9.7 and zeroize 1.9.2, which the 7-day age rule does not yet allow, so a hand-made bump PR (#384) carries it and its branch renovate-components/nv-rs-0.x must stay as it is. With prConcurrentLimit 1 that held branch took the only slot and blocked every other Component's bump. Remove this rule when #384 has merged.
Every Component bump is the same: move the submodule to the tag and refresh both lock files.
